Container.Name: YouKeep
Container.Overview: Self-hosted archiver for YouTube videos, music and podcasts. Subscribe to channels, artists and shows, download them with yt-dlp, and browse, search and stream your library from a web UI. Create the admin account on first visit.

Config.Name: Videos
Config.Description: Where archived YouTube videos and thumbnails are stored. Must be writable by PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Where music tracks are stored. Must be writable by PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: Podcasts
Config.Description: Where podcast episodes are stored. Must be writable by PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the appdata and written files (Unraid 'nobody' = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the appdata and written files (Unraid 'users' = 100).

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Leave empty for auto-detection (Secure cookies only over HTTPS / X-Forwarded-Proto). Set true or false to force.
